# Rules of the e-invoicing module

The business rules the `e-invoicing` module checks an e-invoice against
once it fits the XML schema of its syntax. The rule identifiers are the
official ones; the messages are the module's own. A finding of a rule
carries its identifier, its severity, its message, the business term it
concerns and the JSON path of the place in the semantic model. The versions
of the sources are listed under [standards](standards.md). The page is
generated from
`src/Modules/EInvoicing/Homeport.Modules.EInvoicing.Domain/Rules/rules.json`.

## EN 16931 core rules

Taken from EN 16931 validation artefacts and checked under the rule sets `en16931`, `xrechnung`, `xrechnung-extension`, `factur-x-basic`, `factur-x-extended`.

| Rule | Business term | Severity | Message |
|---|---|---|---|
| BR-01 | BT-24 | fatal | The invoice carries no specification identifier (BT-24). |
| BR-02 | BT-1 | fatal | The invoice carries no invoice number (BT-1). |
| BR-03 | BT-2 | fatal | The invoice carries no issue date (BT-2). |
| BR-04 | BT-3 | fatal | The invoice carries no invoice type code (BT-3). |
| BR-05 | BT-5 | fatal | The invoice carries no invoice currency code (BT-5). |
| BR-06 | BT-27 | fatal | The invoice names no seller (BT-27). |
| BR-07 | BT-44 | fatal | The invoice names no buyer (BT-44). |
| BR-08 | BG-5 | fatal | The invoice carries no postal address of the seller (BG-5). |
| BR-09 | BT-40 | fatal | The postal address of the seller carries no country code (BT-40). |
| BR-10 | BG-8 | fatal | The invoice carries no postal address of the buyer (BG-8). |
| BR-11 | BT-55 | fatal | The postal address of the buyer carries no country code (BT-55). |
| BR-12 | BT-106 | fatal | The document totals carry no sum of the line net amounts (BT-106). |
| BR-13 | BT-109 | fatal | The document totals carry no total amount without VAT (BT-109). |
| BR-14 | BT-112 | fatal | The document totals carry no total amount with VAT (BT-112). |
| BR-15 | BT-115 | fatal | The document totals carry no amount due for payment (BT-115). |
| BR-16 | BG-25 | fatal | The invoice has no invoice line (BG-25). |
| BR-17 | BT-59 | fatal | A payee (BG-10) is named only when it differs from the seller: it needs a name (BT-59) and must not share the seller's name or identifiers. |
| BR-18 | BT-62 | fatal | The tax representative of the seller (BG-11) carries no name (BT-62). |
| BR-19 | BG-12 | fatal | The tax representative of the seller (BG-11) carries no postal address (BG-12). |
| BR-20 | BT-69 | fatal | The postal address of the seller's tax representative carries no country code (BT-69). |
| BR-21 | BT-126 | fatal | The invoice line carries no line identifier (BT-126). |
| BR-22 | BT-129 | fatal | The invoice line carries no invoiced quantity (BT-129). |
| BR-23 | BT-130 | fatal | The invoiced quantity of the invoice line carries no unit of measure (BT-130). |
| BR-24 | BT-131 | fatal | The invoice line carries no net amount (BT-131). |
| BR-25 | BT-153 | fatal | The invoice line carries no item name (BT-153). |
| BR-26 | BT-146 | fatal | The invoice line carries no item net price (BT-146). |
| BR-27 | BT-146 | fatal | The item net price (BT-146) of the invoice line is missing or negative. |
| BR-28 | BT-148 | fatal | The item gross price (BT-148) of the invoice line is negative. |
| BR-29 | BT-74 | fatal | The end date of the invoicing period (BT-74) lies before its start date (BT-73). |
| BR-30 | BT-135 | fatal | The end date of the invoice line period (BT-135) lies before its start date (BT-134). |
| BR-31 | BT-92 | fatal | The document level allowance carries no amount (BT-92). |
| BR-32 | BT-95 | fatal | The document level allowance carries no VAT category code (BT-95). |
| BR-33 | BT-97 | fatal | The document level allowance carries neither a reason (BT-97) nor a reason code (BT-98). |
| BR-36 | BT-99 | fatal | The document level charge carries no amount (BT-99). |
| BR-37 | BT-102 | fatal | The document level charge carries no VAT category code (BT-102). |
| BR-38 | BT-104 | fatal | The document level charge carries neither a reason (BT-104) nor a reason code (BT-105). |
| BR-41 | BT-136 | fatal | The invoice line allowance carries no amount (BT-136). |
| BR-42 | BT-139 | fatal | The invoice line allowance carries neither a reason (BT-139) nor a reason code (BT-140). |
| BR-43 | BT-141 | fatal | The invoice line charge carries no amount (BT-141). |
| BR-44 | BT-144 | fatal | The invoice line charge carries neither a reason (BT-144) nor a reason code (BT-145). |
| BR-45 | BT-116 | fatal | The VAT breakdown carries no VAT category taxable amount (BT-116). |
| BR-46 | BT-117 | fatal | The VAT breakdown carries no VAT category tax amount (BT-117). |
| BR-47 | BT-118 | fatal | The VAT breakdown carries no VAT category code (BT-118). |
| BR-48 | BT-119 | fatal | The VAT breakdown carries no VAT category rate (BT-119), which only the category 'O', not subject to VAT, may leave out. |
| BR-49 | BT-81 | fatal | The payment instructions carry no payment means type code (BT-81). |
| BR-50 | BT-84 | fatal | The credit transfer carries no payment account identifier (BT-84). |
| BR-51 | BT-87 | fatal, in UBL warning | The payment card primary account number (BT-87) is longer than 10 characters; an invoice carries at most its last digits, never the full number. |
| BR-52 | BT-122 | fatal | The additional supporting document carries no reference (BT-122). |
| BR-53 | BT-111 | fatal | The invoice carries a VAT accounting currency code (BT-6) but no total VAT amount in that currency (BT-111). |
| BR-54 | BG-32 | fatal | The item attribute (BG-32) carries no name (BT-160) or no value (BT-161). |
| BR-55 | BT-25 | fatal | The preceding invoice reference (BG-3) carries no preceding invoice number (BT-25). |
| BR-56 | BT-63 | fatal | The tax representative of the seller (BG-11) carries no VAT identifier (BT-63). |
| BR-57 | BT-80 | fatal | The deliver to address (BG-15) carries no country code (BT-80). |
| BR-61 | BT-84 | fatal | The payment means type code (BT-81) names a credit transfer, but the invoice carries no payment account identifier (BT-84). |
| BR-62 | BT-34 | fatal | The electronic address of the seller (BT-34) names no scheme. |
| BR-63 | BT-49 | fatal | The electronic address of the buyer (BT-49) names no scheme. |
| BR-64 | BT-157 | fatal | The item standard identifier (BT-157) names no scheme. |
| BR-65 | BT-158 | fatal | The item classification identifier (BT-158) names no scheme. |
